title: Picture Imperfect
subtitle: A Mystery Unfolds Behind Closed Doors
summary: In the quiet comfort of his home, Byomkesh Bakshi finds himself restless and discontent—until an unexpected twist pulls him into a new enigma. As daily routines are disrupted, a shadowy puzzle emerges, demanding all of Byomkesh’s legendary deductive skills. Step into a world where every detail matters and nothing is quite as it seems.
